Agent-Commit Tracker

Bringing transparency to AI-generated code.

A GitHub App that reads Pull Requests, extracts context (New vs. Ongoing Conversation), and posts a formatted Markdown report directly into the PR to aid reviewers in understanding AI contributions.

Install App

Features

Context Extraction

Automatically distinguishes between new features and ongoing conversational updates by parsing AI instructions within PRs and Issues.

Formatted PR Reports

Posts a clean, easy-to-read Markdown report directly as a comment on the Pull Request, giving reviewers immediate insight into the AI's intent and changes.

Privacy First

Operates purely on webhook payloads. It never clones your repository, never stores source code, and retains no permanent user data.
